assessment_review_shape.name: assessment_review_shape
assessment_review_shape.value: ("assessments"."source_draft_id" IS NULL AND "assessments"."criterion_decisions" IS NULL) OR ("assessments"."source_draft_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assessments"."source_draft_id" <> "assessments"."id" AND "assessments"."status" = 'finalized' AND jsonb_typeof("assessments"."criterion_decisions") = 'object' AND "assessments"."criterion_decisions" IS NOT NULL)

assessment_finalization_complete.name: assessment_finalization_complete
assessment_finalization_complete.value: ("assessments"."status" = 'draft' AND "assessments"."finalized_by" IS NULL AND "assessments"."finalized_at" IS NULL) OR ("assessments"."status" = 'finalized' AND "assessments"."finalized_by" IS NOT NULL AND "assessments"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)

run_lease_state.name: run_lease_state
run_lease_state.value: ("evaluation_runs"."status" = 'running' AND "evaluation_runs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "evaluation_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("evaluation_runs"."status" <> 'running' AND "evaluation_runs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "evaluation_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

payout_success_has_item.name: payout_success_has_item
payout_success_has_item.value: "payouts"."status" <> 'succeeded' OR ("payouts"."paypal_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payouts"."reconciled_at" IS NOT NULL)
